releaseTitle: echo v2.4.1 - Full-Volume Audio Fix & Playback Polish
releaseNotes:
• Restored full unattenuated playback loudness by bypassing Android Equalizer DSP on flat presets
• Boosted Volume Normalization target gain to +6.0 dB (600 mB) for consistent, punchy audio output
• Fixed unintended intro/outro volume dimming by defaulting single-player Crossfade to Off and ensuring 100% volume reset on track transitions
